summary: Add explicit session leases with heartbeat and expiry
description: Replace the conservative assumption that every gateway routing row is an active session with durable lease ownership, heartbeat, expiry and crash recovery semantics.
acceptance: R1 session_leases records owner platform acquire heartbeat and expiry; R2 gateway acquires renews and releases leases; R3 crash-expired leases recover without losing resumable routing; R4 maintenance protects valid leases and classifies expired leases; R5 multi-process race and restart tests pass.

evidence.summary: R1-R5 implemented: durable atomic session leases with owner/platform/acquire/heartbeat/expiry; gateway acquire-renew-release lifecycle; expired-owner crash recovery preserves open session routing; maintenance protects active and classifies/removes expired leases; multiprocess race/restart coverage. Verification: 249 targeted tests passed, go-workflow validate passed, git diff check passed. Broad gateway+CLI run previously exposed 21 failures; the 2 regressions caused by this diff were repaired and included in the 249 green rerun; remaining failures are unrelated baseline/dependency issues. Runtime deliberately not restarted: gateway PID 1656285 remains active with NRestarts=0.
